title: Bind values and choose concrete types
summary: Distinguish mutability from shadowing, and use tuples, arrays and explicitly typed numeric values.

unsigned.clue: Unsigned 32-bit integer type for the constant LIMIT

mutable.clue: Modifier allowing assignment to count after its declaration

shadow.clue: Keyword introducing a new binding named spaces with a different type

signed.clue: Signed 32-bit integer type for the negative tuple element

boolean.clue: Type of a true-or-false tuple element

character.clue: Type representing one Unicode scalar value

array.clue: Array type holding exactly three unsigned 32-bit integers

equal.clue: Macro comparing the incremented count to 3
